segments.name: Private market investment solutions
segments.description: Provides private markets investment solutions, including customized separate accounts, specialized funds, advisory and related services, to institutional and private wealth clients worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company is managed as one reportable segment that provides private market investment solutions.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay management and advisory fees, incentive fees and subscription fees for private markets investment solutions and services.
revenueModel.evidence: A significant portion of our management and advisory fee revenue base is contractual in nature and is based on the long-term nature of our specialized funds and customized separate accounts as well as long-term relationships with many of our clients
